=RATE(10,-100,1000): Iterative solver: the root is 0; Excel stops at -2e-10, we stop at -3e-10.
=IRR({-70000,12000,15000,18000,21000,260: Iterative solver: Excel stops short of the root (agrees to 13 digits); our NPV residual is smaller.
=XIRR({-10000,2750,4250,3250,2750},{3944: Iterative solver: Excel stops with an NPV residual of about 1e-6, ours is about 1e-12. Agrees to 9 digits.
